ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.ca: Cables carry EU between generators, transformers and machines - pick a cable for the voltage and amperage you need.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.co: The controller turns the structure into a working machine; only then can the network connect.
Covers mount on machines and pipes: conveyor (items), pump (fluids), machine controller (auto I/O) and more.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.fl: Fluid pipes move fluids; larger pipes have higher throughput, and a pump cover or valve lets fluid in or out.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.it: Item pipes move items between inventories: use a conveyor module to extract from a source and route to the destination.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.pump.narrati: This is %s - it pumps fluids out of the world into pipes and tanks.

ponder.gtsnponder.power.combustion.narra: This is %s - a generator that burns fuel to produce EU for the power grid.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.combustion.title: Power grid: Large Combustion Engine
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.burnin: Cable burning: a cable carrying more current than its gauge allows burns out - size the cable (1x / 2x / 4x...) to the amperage.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.contro: The controller is the front-center block: supply the correct voltage to form the structure.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.overvo: Overvoltage: feeding a machine a tier above its rating quadruples its energy cost and can damage or destroy it.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.voltag: GT power comes in voltage tiers (ULV, LV, MV, HV...). A machine only accepts its own tier; a transformer converts between tiers.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.transformer.narr: This is %s - it steps energy between voltage tiers so machines join the right grid.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lp_steam_furnace: This is the Low Pressure Steam Furnace - a bronze-age smelter that runs on steam.
Feed in ore or food and plenty of steam: it smelts one item at a time and needs no power cable.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lv_macerator.int: This is the Basic Macerator - the LV workhorse that grinds ores into dusts.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lv_macerator.usa: Put ore in the input slot, give it LV power, and pull the dust from the output slot.
